## YERSINIA ENTEROCOLITICA
Antimicrobials are indicated only for patients with severe disease or immune
compromise.
## Primary treatment of gastroenteritis
Hydration and electrolyte replacement
## Antimicrobial treatment of severe gastroenteritis or immunocompromised patient
Preferred:
## Inpatient

[Ciprofloxacin 500 mg PO q12h for 5 days [R,DI]](psjzid-ciprofloxacin-500mg-po-q12h)
Alternative:
[Trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole 1 DS tablet q12h for 5 days [R,DI]](psjzid-trimeth-sulfa-1-ds-tab-bid)
